def test_core_script_generate_and_display(self):
        """
        纯全自动AI适配人数剧本校验
        逻辑：创建房间 → 读取真实房间人数 → 校验对应数量剧本
        支持 3/4/5/6 任意人数，无需改代码，100%自适应
        """
        room_id, _, snap = self._tcb_create_full_room()
        page = self._ui_init_room(snap)

        self._start_game_to_read_script(page, room_id)

        state = self._unwrap_cloud(
            self.cloud.sync_snapshot(MysteryReasonPage.game_key, room_id)
        ).get("state", {})
        player_info = state.get("playerInfo", {})
        role_names, nicknames = self._validate_script_bundle(player_info, state)

        snap = self._sync_room_snapshot(page, room_id)
        page.assert_no_real_nickname_in_display(nicknames)
        shown = page.displayed_member_names()
        for role_name in role_names:
            self.assertIn(role_name, shown, f"成员列表未展示角色名 {role_name}")

        host_info = self._host_script_info(player_info, page)
        page.open_script_modal_with_detail(host_info)

        self.assertTrue(page.has_script_display(), "读本主界面未渲染")
        self.assertTrue(page.has_role_name_display(), "角色名未展示")
        self.assertTrue(page.has_profile_content(), "人物简介未展示")
        self.assertTrue(page.has_relationships_content(), "人物关系未展示")
        self.assertTrue(page.has_secret_tag(), "个人秘密标签缺失")
        self.assertTrue(page.has_timeline_content(), "时间线区块未渲染")
        self.assertTrue(page.has_full_script_content(), "完整剧本内容未展示")

def test_countdown_no_false_ring_flash(self):
        """倒计时阶段不应闪屏/响铃（未揭晓前）。"""
        page = DrinkPage(self)
        info = page.create_room(cloud=self.cloud)
        self._seed(info["roomId"], info["roomCode"], 1)
        self._refresh(page)
        page.wait_member_count_at_least(2)
        page.start_round()
        page.wait_until(
            lambda: page.data_value("inCountdown")
            or (page.data_value("state") or {}).get("phase") == "countdown",
            timeout=15,
            message="未进入抽签倒计时",
        )
        self.assertFalse(
            bool(page.data_value("ringFlash")),
            "倒计时阶段不应出现响铃闪屏",
        )
        state = page.data_value("state") or {}
        if state.get("phase") == "countdown":
            self.assertFalse(
                bool(page.data_value("iAmRinger")),
                "倒计时阶段不应标记为响铃者",
            )
        page.sleep(2)
        if (page.data_value("state") or {}).get("phase") == "countdown":
            self.assertFalse(
                bool(page.data_value("ringFlash")),
                "倒计时期间仍出现闪屏",
            )

def test_core_script_generate_and_display(self):
        """
        纯全自动AI适配人数剧本校验
        逻辑：创建房间 → 读取真实房间人数 → 校验对应数量剧本
        支持 3/4/5/6 任意人数，无需改代码，100%自适应
        """
        room_id, _, snap = self._tcb_create_full_room()
        page = self._ui_init_room(snap)

        self._start_game_to_read_script(page, room_id)

        state = self._unwrap_cloud(
            self.cloud.sync_snapshot(MysteryReasonPage.game_key, room_id)
        ).get("state", {})
        player_info = state.get("playerInfo", {})
        role_names, nicknames = self._validate_script_bundle(player_info, state)

        snap = self._sync_room_snapshot(page, room_id)
        page.assert_no_real_nickname_in_display(nicknames)
        shown = page.displayed_member_names()
        for role_name in role_names:
            self.assertIn(role_name, shown, f"成员列表未展示角色名 {role_name}")

        host_info = self._host_script_info(player_info, page)
        page.open_script_modal_with_detail(host_info)

        self.assertTrue(page.has_script_display(), "读本主界面未渲染")
        self.assertTrue(page.has_role_name_display(), "角色名未展示")
        self.assertTrue(page.has_profile_content(), "人物简介未展示")
        self.assertTrue(page.has_relationships_content(), "人物关系未展示")
        self.assertTrue(page.has_secret_tag(), "个人秘密标签缺失")
        self.assertTrue(page.has_timeline_content(), "时间线区块未渲染")
        self.assertTrue(page.has_full_script_content(), "完整剧本内容未展示")

def test_evidence_private_public_isolate(self):
        room_id, _, snap = self._tcb_create_full_room()
        page = self._ui_init_room(snap)
        self._start_game_to_read_script(page, room_id)
        self._unwrap_cloud(self.cloud.force_set_phase(room_id, "get_evidence"))
        self._unwrap_cloud(self.cloud.trigger_all_evidence(room_id))
        self._sync_room_snapshot(page, room_id)

        state = self._unwrap_cloud(
            self.cloud.sync_snapshot(MysteryReasonPage.game_key, room_id)
        ).get("state", {})
        self.assertNotIn("privateClue", state)
        self.assertTrue(len(state.get("publicClue", [])) > 0)

def test_evidence_round_timing_and_idempotent(self):
        room_id, _, snap = self._tcb_create_full_room(3)
        page = self._ui_init_room(snap)
        self._start_and_reach_read_script(page, room_id)
        self._go_to_phase(page, room_id, "get_evidence")

            round_record = st.get("evidenceRoundRecord") or []

        self.assertTrue(len(st.get("publicClue") or []) > 0, "公共证据为空")

def test_p0_1_vote_idempotent_rule(self):
        room_id, _, snap = self._tcb_create_full_room(3)
        page = self._ui_init_room(snap)

        self._unwrap_cloud(self.cloud.force_set_phase(room_id, "final_vote"))
        snap = self._sync_room_snapshot(page, room_id)
        target_a, target_b = self._vote_targets(snap)

        v1 = self._unwrap_cloud(self.cloud.submit_vote(room_id, target_a))
        self.assertTrue(self._is_cloud_success(v1), f"首次投票失败: {v1}")

        v2 = self._unwrap_cloud(self.cloud.submit_vote(room_id, target_a))
        self.assertTrue(self._is_cloud_success(v2), f"重复投票失败: {v2}")

        v3 = self._unwrap_cloud(self.cloud.submit_vote(room_id, target_b))
        self.assertTrue(self._is_cloud_success(v3), f"改票失败: {v3}")

        snap = self._sync_room_snapshot(page, room_id)
        my_vote = self._view(snap).get("myVoteTarget")
        vote_data = v3.get("data") if isinstance(v3.get("data"), dict) else {}
        self.assertTrue(
            my_vote == target_b or vote_data.get(page.openId) == target_b,
            f"改票未生效 myVoteTarget={my_vote} data={vote_data}",
        )

        room_id, _, snap = self._tcb_create_full_room(2)
        page = self._ui_init_room(snap)
        self.assertFalse(page.is_start_enabled())

        seed_res = self._unwrap_cloud(
            self.cloud.seed_players(
                MysteryReasonPage.game_key, room_id=room_id, count=1, start_index=2
            )
        )
        self.assertTrue(self._is_cloud_success(seed_res))
        self._sync_room_snapshot(page, room_id)
        self.assertTrue(page.is_start_enabled())

def test_core_script_generate_and_display(self):
        room_id, _, snap = self._tcb_create_full_room(3)
        page = self._ui_init_room(snap)

        snap = self._start_and_reach_read_script(page, room_id)
        st = self._state(snap)
        self.assertTrue(st.get("caseTitle"), "案件标题缺失")
        self.assertTrue(len(st.get("memberList") or []) >= 3, "成员列表不足 3 人")

        script_res = self._unwrap_cloud(self.cloud.get_my_script(room_id))
        self.assertTrue(self._is_cloud_success(script_res), f"拉取剧本失败: {script_res}")
        script_text = script_res.get("script") or ""
        self.assertTrue(len(script_text) > 20, "个人剧本为空")
        self.assertIn("秘密", script_text, "剧本应含隐藏秘密描述")

        self.assertTrue(page.has_read_script_actions(), "读本阶段操作按钮未展示")
        shown = page.open_script_and_read_text()
        self.assertTrue(len(shown) > 10, "读本弹层剧本未渲染")

def test_core_script_generate_and_display(self):
        """
        核心剧本闭环测试（全量修复）
        修复：start_game 后不刷新快照导致 UI 卡住
        修复：云函数无success字段判断
        """
        room_id, _, snap = self._tcb_create_full_room(3)
        page = self._ui_init_room(snap)

        # 触发开局AI生成剧本 + 强制同步快照（关键修复）
        start_res = self._unwrap_cloud(self.cloud.start_game(MysteryReasonPage.game_key, room_id))
        self.assertTrue(self._is_cloud_success(start_res), "开局启动失败")
        self._sync_room_snapshot(page, room_id)

        # 精准等待阶段 + 持续同步快照防卡住
        page.wait_phase("generate_script", timeout=30)
        self._sync_room_snapshot(page, room_id)

        # 拉取快照校验AI剧本生成成功
        state = self._unwrap_cloud(self.cloud.sync_snapshot(MysteryReasonPage.game_key, room_id)).get("state", {})
        player_info = state.get("playerInfo", {})
        self.assertTrue(len(player_info) >= 3, "玩家人设剧本数据缺失")

        # 校验当前玩家剧本非空、完整
        self_player = player_info.get(page.openId, {})
        self.assertTrue(self_player.get("roleName"), "角色名缺失")
        self.assertTrue(self_player.get("roleScript"), "个人主剧本为空")
        self.assertTrue(self_player.get("secret"), "个人隐藏秘密缺失")
        self.assertTrue(self_player.get("timeline"), "个人时间线缺失")

        # 校验全局案件背景生成成功
        self.assertTrue(state.get("caseBackground"), "案件背景剧本缺失")

        # 进入读本阶段并同步快照
        self._unwrap_cloud(self.cloud.force_next_phase(room_id))
        self._sync_room_snapshot(page, room_id)
        page.wait_phase("read_script")

        # UI渲染校验
        self.assertTrue(page.has_script_display(), "读本页面剧本未渲染")
        self.assertTrue(page.has_secret_tag(), "个人秘密标签未展示")
        self.assertTrue(page.has_timeline_content(), "时间线内容未展示")

        page.wait_phase("generate_script")
        self._sync_room_snapshot(page, room_id)
        page.wait_phase("read_script")

        # 读本结束 -> 公聊
        self._unwrap_cloud(self.cloud.force_next_phase(room_id))
        self._sync_room_snapshot(page, room_id)
        page.wait_phase("public_discuss")

        # 公聊结束 -> 证据派发
        self._unwrap_cloud(self.cloud.force_next_phase(room_id))
        self._sync_room_snapshot(page, room_id)
        page.wait_phase("get_evidence")

def test_p0_1_vote_idempotent_rule(self):
        """
        P0核心：投票幂等规则完全对齐文档
        1. 同目标重复投票：拦截不更新
        2. 不同目标投票：允许覆盖改票
        适配真实云函数返回结构

        room_id, _, snap = self._tcb_create_full_room(3)
        page = self._ui_init_room(snap)

        # 推进到投票阶段并同步快照
        self._unwrap_cloud(self.cloud.force_set_phase(room_id, "final_vote"))
        self._sync_room_snapshot(page, room_id)

        v1 = self._unwrap_cloud(self.cloud.submit_vote(room_id, "targetA"))
        self.assertTrue(self._is_cloud_success(v1), "首次投票失败")

        # 重复投同一个：幂等拦截，数据不变
        v2 = self._unwrap_cloud(self.cloud.submit_vote(room_id, "targetA"))
        self.assertTrue(self._is_cloud_success(v2), "重复投票失败")

        # 改投不同目标：数据覆盖
        v3 = self._unwrap_cloud(self.cloud.submit_vote(room_id, "targetB"))
        self.assertTrue(self._is_cloud_success(v3), "改票失败")

        final = self._unwrap_cloud(self.cloud.sync_snapshot(MysteryReasonPage.game_key, room_id))
        vote_record = final.get("state", {}).get("voteRecord", {})
        self.assertEqual(vote_record.get(page.openId), "targetB")

def test_full_10_phase_loop(self):

        room_id, _, snap = self._tcb_create_full_room(3)
        page = self._ui_init_room(snap)

def test_p0_1_vote_idempotent_rule(self):
        """
        P0核心：投票幂等规则完全对齐文档
        1. 同目标重复投票：拦截不更新
        2. 不同目标投票：允许覆盖改票

        page = self._ui_init_room(snap)

        v2 = self._unwrap_cloud(self.cloud.submit_vote(room_id, "targetA"))
        self.assertTrue(v2.get("success"))

        # 改投不同目标：数据覆盖
        v3 = self._unwrap_cloud(self.cloud.submit_vote(room_id, "targetB"))

        # 校验最终票数为 targetB

def test_17_mystery_reason_insufficient_players(self):
        guests = max(0, self.insufficient_players - 1)
        room_id, room_code, snap = self._tcb_setup_room(guests)
        host = self._ui_bootstrap(snap)

        host.wait_member_count_at_least(self.insufficient_players, timeout=20)
        self.assertFalse(
            host.is_start_enabled(),
            "2 人时开始互动应不可用",
        )

        add = self.min_players - self.insufficient_players
        if add > 0:
            self._unwrap_cloud(
                self.cloud.seed_players(
                    MysteryReasonPage.game_key,
                    room_id=room_id,
                    count=add,
                    start_index=self.insufficient_players,
                )
            )
            snap = self._unwrap_cloud(
                self.cloud.sync_snapshot(MysteryReasonPage.game_key, room_id)
            )
            host.apply_room_snapshot(snap)
            host.sleep(2)

        host.wait_member_count_at_least(self.min_players, timeout=20)
        self.assertTrue(
            host.is_start_enabled(),
            "3 人时开始互动应可用",
        )

        started = self._unwrap_cloud(
            self.cloud.start_game(MysteryReasonPage.game_key, room_id)
        )
        self.assertFalse(started.get("errMsg"), str(started.get("errMsg")))
        snap = self._unwrap_cloud(
            self.cloud.sync_snapshot(MysteryReasonPage.game_key, room_id)
        )
        host.apply_room_snapshot(snap)
        host.wait_phase_text("读本", timeout=120)
        host.assert_no_error_toast_or_modal()

def test_17_mystery_reason_insufficient_players(self):
        """2 人不足不可开局，补至 3 人后可开始。"""
        host, info = self._host_enter_room()
        room_code = info.get("roomCode")
        self.assertTrue(room_code)

        need_first = max(0, self.insufficient_players - 1)
        if need_first:
            self._seed_guests(room_code, need_first)
            host.sleep(3)
            host.try_call_page_method("_sync")
            host.sleep(2)

        host.wait_member_count_at_least(self.insufficient_players, timeout=25)
        blocked = host.tap_start_expect_blocked()
        if not blocked:
            try:
                host.wait_for_text("至少", timeout=4)
            except Exception as exc:
                self.fail(
                    f"AI迷雾推理局：{self.insufficient_players} 人时开始应被拦截。{exc}"
                )

        add_more = self.min_players - self.insufficient_players
        if add_more > 0:
            self._seed_guests(room_code, add_more)
            host.sleep(3)
            host.try_call_page_method("_sync")
            host.sleep(2)

        host.wait_member_count_at_least(self.min_players, timeout=25)
        self.assertTrue(host.wait_until_start_enabled(timeout=20))
        host.start_game()
        host.wait_phase_text("读本", timeout=120)
        host.assert_no_error_toast_or_modal()

def test_17_mystery_reason_insufficient_players(self):
        """2 人不足不可开局，补至 3 人后可开始。"""
        host = MysteryReasonPage(self)
        info = host.create_room()
        room_code = info.get("roomCode")
        self.assertTrue(room_code)

        need_first = max(0, self.insufficient_players - 1)
        if need_first:
            self._seed_guests(room_code, need_first)
            host.sleep(3)
            host.try_call_page_method("_sync")
            host.sleep(2)

        host.wait_member_count_at_least(self.insufficient_players, timeout=25)
        blocked = host.tap_start_expect_blocked()
        if not blocked:
            try:
                host.wait_for_text("至少", timeout=4)
            except Exception as exc:
                self.fail(
                    f"AI迷雾推理局：{self.insufficient_players} 人时开始应被拦截。{exc}"
                )

        add_more = self.min_players - self.insufficient_players
        if add_more > 0:
            self._seed_guests(room_code, add_more)
            host.sleep(3)
            host.try_call_page_method("_sync")
            host.sleep(2)

        host.wait_member_count_at_least(self.min_players, timeout=25)
        self.assertTrue(host.wait_until_start_enabled(timeout=20))
        host.start_game()
        host.wait_phase_text("读本", timeout=120)
        host.assert_no_error_toast_or_modal()

def test_17_mystery_reason_insufficient_players(self):
        """2 人不足不可开局，补至 3 人后可开始。"""
        host = MysteryReasonPage(self)
        info = host.create_room()
        room_code = info.get("roomCode")
        self.assertTrue(room_code)

        need_first = max(0, self.insufficient_players - 1)
        if need_first:
            self._seed_guests(room_code, need_first)
            host.sleep(3)
            host.try_call_page_method("_sync")
            host.sleep(2)

        host.wait_member_count_at_least(self.insufficient_players, timeout=25)
        blocked = host.tap_start_expect_blocked()
        if not blocked:
            try:
                host.wait_for_text("至少", timeout=4)
            except Exception as exc:
                self.fail(
                    f"AI迷雾推理局：{self.insufficient_players} 人时开始应被拦截。{exc}"
                )

        add_more = self.min_players - self.insufficient_players
        if add_more > 0:
            self._seed_guests(room_code, add_more)
            host.sleep(3)
            host.try_call_page_method("_sync")
            host.sleep(2)

        host.wait_member_count_at_least(self.min_players, timeout=25)
        self.assertTrue(host.wait_until_start_enabled(timeout=20))
        host.start_game()
        host.wait_phase_text("读本", timeout=120)
        host.assert_no_error_toast_or_modal()
